_doc: Spell symbols: 50 battle and 10 adventure spells, plus the five school emblems. 32x32 symbols on a transparent background, docs/art/classes/icons.md. One generate-image-v2 call at 32x32 returns 64 candidates of a mixed subject ("each image a different one of these"); the best take per subject is accepted. Frames (school, grade) are drawn by code, never baked. Never downscaled or mirrored. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.concept: poultice thornskin nettle feed regrow sprout bramble-row ripen orchard-day second-spring
recipes.subject: Subject: each image shows exactly one of these 10 things, each thing about equally often: (1) a rolled white cloth bandage with a green herb leaf tied on it; (2) a green vine coiled into a ring with big sharp thorns; (3) a jagged stinging nettle sprig dripping one purple-green poison drop; (4) a bulging brown sack of seeds with a green leaf sticking out; (5) a cut tree stump with a fresh green shoot growing from it; (6) a seed split open with a little two-leaf sprout popping out; (7) a tangle of brown bramble branches covered in thorns; (8) a big ripe shiny red apple with one green leaf; (9) a small round fruit tree full of red apples; (10) a big pink spring blossom flower with green leaves.

recipes.concept: call-the-boat scuttle lily-road fair-wind tidal-wave seafaring
recipes.subject: Subject: each image shows exactly one of these 6 things, each thing about equally often: (1) a small round wooden rowing boat with a blue sail and a shiny brass hand bell hanging above it; (2) a small brown wooden boat tipped nose up and sinking, a big hole in its side and round purple bubbles rising; (3) three round green lily pads in a row with one pink water lily flower on the middle pad; (4) a fat white canvas sail on a short wooden mast, bulging full, a pale blue swirl of wind behind it; (5) a big curling deep blue ocean wave with a white foam crest; (6) a round wooden ship's steering wheel with eight spokes and brass caps on the handles.
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.159: the five naval spells (NAVAL 7.1-7.2) and the Seafaring skill (7.3, kind skill, picked as skill:seafaring). Fair Wind is a sail, not a cloud, so it is not mistaken for Gust; Seafaring is a wheel, not the Trailcraft compass.
